name: @aiappfactory/ai-core
description: Natural language -> App Spec generation with a validate/self-repair loop (04_IMPLEMENTATION E2-6/E2-7). The model only ever emits a T1/T2 Spec via a strict structured-output tool call — never arbitrary code (ADR-001) — and @aiappfactory/app-spec's validator, not the model, is the final word on whether the result is acceptable.
